workhorse: Composite score (0-100): 30% cost + 25% capabilities + 20% context + 20% speed + 5% reliability. Higher = better everyday model.
intelligence: Model capability (0-100): from AA intelligence index or median benchmark score. Higher = smarter.
coding: Software engineering capability (0-100): from AA coding index or benchmark scores.
value: Intelligence per dollar (0-100): intelligence / blended_price. Higher = more bang for buck.
speed: Inference speed (0-100): from throughput (TPS) or latency data. Higher = faster.
reliability: Provider reliability (0-100): based on setup difficulty, batch API, HTTPS. Higher = more dependable.
tool_calling: Function/tool use capability (0-100): from model metadata. Higher = better for agents.
agentic: Multi-step autonomous capability (0-100): from tool calling + structured output. Higher = better for agents.
research: Search + synthesis capability (0-100): correlated with intelligence. Higher = better for research.
hot_deal: Exceptional temporary economics (discount, promo, free trial).
worker: Cheap repeated tasks, sub-agents, bulk processing.
punches_above: Small/cheap model that performs above its price class.
price_known: true=price confirmed, false=price unknown (do NOT treat null as $0).
verification_status: verified=found on official page, likely=strong evidence, community_reported=only community sources.
rpd: Requests per day. null=unknown (do NOT assume unlimited).
